page.title: Users
page.intro: Who can sign in to this portal for your organization. Invite colleagues, disable those who left, and help those who lost their authenticator or their password.
page.forbiddenTitle: Only a customer administrator can manage users
page.forbiddenText: Your SOC decides who administers your organization's users. Ask your SOC contact if you need to be one.
page.issueFailed: Could not issue a temporary password.

confirm.disableText: They will not be able to sign in, and a session they have open ends. You can enable them again.
confirm.resetTotpText: They sign in with their password alone, and can set up two-factor authentication again from their Profile.
confirm.temporaryPasswordText: Their current password stops working. They sign in with the temporary one and choose their own.

tags.adminTitle: Manages this customer's users. Appointed by your SOC.
tags.passwordTitle: Signs in with a temporary password and must choose their own
tags.readOnlyTitle: Can view your data but not change it

invite.title: Invite a user
invite.introEmail: They receive a temporary password by email and choose their own at their first sign-in.
invite.introShown: They receive a temporary password from you: it is shown once after the invitation and choose their own at their first sign-in.

problems.usernameInvalid: Username must be 3 to 64 characters: letters, digits and . _ {'@'} -, starting with a letter or a digit

invite.readOnlyHint: They can view everything but change nothing: no comments, cases, status changes or reports.

temporaryPassword.title: A temporary password for {username}
temporaryPassword.shownOnce: This password is shown once. Give it to {username} yourself. They choose their own at their first sign-in.
temporaryPassword.shownOnceProblem: This password is shown once. Give it to {username} yourself: {problem} They choose their own at their first sign-in.
temporaryPassword.emailed: A temporary password was emailed to {email}. {username} chooses their own at their first sign-in.
